steps.say: This is the real Lithrim product, an evaluation workspace for clinical AI agents. A user just opens it and starts talking. The agent under test here is a clinical scribe that drafts visit notes.

steps.value: Create a risk judge for clinical scribe notes
steps.say: First they ask, in plain English, for a new judge, a focused reviewer that watches for one specific kind of mistake.

The agent does it for real. It reads the current agent, then authors a risk judge with genuine clinical nuance, and hands back an editable judge with a full who, when, what and why audit trail. Nothing is hidden; every change is recorded.

steps.value: Run the live in-process verdict so the judges actually re-run. Surface the cost-confirm.
steps.say: Now they run the real thing, the actual council, real model calls, not a cached replay.
The assistant can surface the cost gate, but it cannot spend. Only the human authorizes a paid run.

And here is the part nothing else can do. A language model judge can be confidently, fluently wrong. So a deterministic floor, grounded in the source the judge never read, checks every finding and quietly overrules any it cannot ground in the actual record. That is a verdict a panel of judges, on its own, cannot give you.

steps.value: Pull up the case and show the planted label - true positives or over-fires?
steps.say: They can hold it against ground truth, the real source case with the planted defect shown inline.
The product reads its own verdict honestly: which findings are true positives that match the planted defect, and which are over-fires to calibrate away.

steps.value: Open the JudgeEditor for risk_judge and run the Optimize calibration trainer.
steps.say: So they calibrate the judge, and ask the only question that matters: did the change actually help?

The calibration trainer compiles few-shot demos from a by-construction split and measures the honest held-out delta on a fixed test set. And it tells the truth: if the tune did not move the number, it shows you the loss, and refuses to loosen the gate to manufacture a win. No green vanity metric, the real result, win or loss.
Author, run, ground against the source, calibrate honestly. The whole loop, live, every step audited. That is what makes a verdict you can actually trust. That is Lithrim.
